result.description: Open-source Postgres backend platform: database, auth, storage, edge functions, realtime, with auto-generated REST API and a Management API.
result.auth_detail: Management API (api.supabase.com): Bearer token via personal access token (scoped or classic) or OAuth2 (auth-code, for third-party integrations). Per-project data API (PostgREST): publishable/secret API keys (+ user JWTs).
result.access_detail: Free plan signup, anyone can create PATs and register OAuth apps in the dashboard. Free projects pause after 1 week inactivity. No app review found for OAuth apps.
result.api_notes: Management API covers orgs, projects, config, migrations, branches, functions, secrets, logs, etc. (120 req/min). Each project also gets auto-generated PostgREST REST API, plus pg_graphql, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions APIs.

evidence.quote: OAuth2 allows your application to generate tokens on behalf of a Supabase user, providing secure and limited access to their account without requiring their credentials.
PATs are tokens with a custom expiry that you manually generate to access the Management API.
